0.content:
An unnamed elderly woman in the Inazuman countryside. One bitter winter night a half-frozen kitten slipped into her house and fell asleep in a box by the door; she let it stay, fed it nekomanma by the fire, named it Kirara and told it story after story about youkai, festivals and the food of other nations for many winters. On a later winter night, when Granny was slow to return home, Kirara climbed a great tree to search for her and became a nekomata. Kirara still runs home in cat form whenever she can, curls up in Granny's lap, and leaves "mystery packages" at the door.

Granny thinks her cat simply goes out to play for longer and longer. She has noticed that the house is cleaned and breakfast made while she sleeps, and has jokingly asked whether her little cat grew up into a youkai who looks after her. Kirara answers with an innocent stretch and yawn. In the Vision story, Granny met a two-tailed young woman with a Vision who offered to walk her home through the snow. Canon does not say whether Granny realised who she was.

1.comment: Kirara: Yae Miko, the Lady Kitsune
1.content:
Kirara calls Yae Miko "the greatest and coolest youkai". The Guuji visited her in person and taught her human etiquette, how to approach people and some fried-tofu recipes, which, Kirara suspects, were for Yae's own benefit. When she saw how Kirara treasured Inazuma City's streets, she told her that a youkai who wants to blend in must work like a human, and recommended Komaniya Express. She added that parcels for Guuji Yae must always take top priority. Yae says she can hardly dislike "a little youkai" who takes them out to dinner and pays.

In Simulanka (limited event) Kirara recalled drinking with Guuji Yae, who bet her a round of dried fish on a cup game. A shrine maiden, Miyuki, later told her every cup had hidden an umeboshi, which taught Kirara she still has a long way to go before becoming a great youkai. In a 2025 mail from Sayu, Kirara visits the shrine and whispers and laughs with the Guuji; right afterwards a shrine maiden sends Sayu to the Aisa Bathhouse on a "mission" to nap. The mail implies, without saying outright, that the two of them planned it.

2.comment: Kirara: Chiori and the Whirling Bloom outfit
2.content:
Chiori first knew Kirara as a green-eyed cat that followed her into the Inazuman wilds while she looked for dyes and fabrics. Years later Kirara arrived at Chiori's shop to deliver a parcel, dressed in every trend she had copied, with a garish flower in her hair. Chiori said she looked like a cat dropped into a bucket of paint and declared that only her shoes had any taste. Kirara pointed out that those were her feet. Chiori dragged her into a fitting room and made Whirling Bloom, her current outfit. Kirara now handles Chioriya Boutique's international deliveries and sends customers who ask about her clothes to Chiori. Clients now want shoes shaped like cat paw pads.

Chiori is brusque, but Kirara calls her "really nice to me". Chiori worries that Kirara will leave claw marks on her textiles, and Kirara insists she never would. In Chiori's Story Quest (4.5) Chiori calls her "Komaniya Express's most reliable courier". Worried that Chiori's temper would cause a scandal, Kirara asked the Traveler to go after her, because as a Komaniya employee she felt she should not get involved herself.

3.content:
Komaniya Express is Inazuma's most trusted delivery company. Kirara is its only Gold Level Courier, a rank the owner made up for her after she quietly emptied the Undelivered Packages section. The owner admitted that at first they thought the warehouse had been robbed. As the company expanded abroad she took every international route, because a youkai is fastest, and she says she gets "paid to travel". Customers praise her on the feedback board as "safe and punctual", "service assured" and "vivacious and adorable". Rules forbid transactions between staff and clients, so she cannot accept gifts openly.

She takes the company's reputation personally. She drums up business wherever she goes: she asked Gorou to promote it on Watatsumi Island and asks for five-star reviews. As a kitten she knew Komaniya only for its big, comfy boxes, and her favourite box still has its logo. Her boss gives her a paid day off on her birthday and long holidays.

4.content: During a limited-time 3.7 event, when Genius Invokation TCG fever was spreading, Kirara got lost in Liyue Harbor delivering to Hu Tao. The Traveler and Kazuha showed her the way, and Hu Tao rattled her by asking whether Komaniya could ship people "in-between alive and dead". She kept crossing paths with the Traveler and the reporter Charlotte. In Ritou, Kokomi deduced that the "Card Snatcher" was using Kirara's parcels, all bound for one Sumeru address, to smuggle stolen treasure-chest card backs. Kirara refused to open a customer's parcel but let the group follow her if they hid, then delivered to the recipient near Caravan Ribat. She used her tails as a signal (one raised, one lowered meant "thieves") and tried a clumsy fib about it being her "100th delivery" to get the parcel opened.

5.comment: Kirara: Uther's ambush and Fontaine Fashion Week (4.5)
5.content: In Chiori's Story Quest (Cisoria Chapter, 4.5), Kirara arrived late with an order and could not hide why, because her tails gave her away. Bandits had been hired to target "a courier with two tails". She beat them easily, handed them to the Gardes and learned that they had been hired by the rival designer Uther, who was trying to hurt Chiori's business. Chiori arranged an escort of the Special Patrol and the Spina di Rosula to see Kirara to the border, and Navia came along herself with a batch of macarons as a going-away gift. Kirara later returned and opened Fashion Week with Navia, both floating down onto the stage on an open umbrella. She helped hang Chiori's new signboard and asked only for more international orders as thanks.

6.content:
During the limited-time 4.8 event Summertide Scales and Tales, Kirara napped in a box with an old book as her pillow and woke in Simulanka, the storybook world of the Hexenzirkel witches Alice, Barbeloth and Andersdotter, already wearing the "Phantom in Boots" outfit. She wandered Constellation Metropole alone for a day thinking a great youkai had swallowed her, until the Traveler, Paimon and Nilou found her talking in her sleep about fish. Clockwork residents cast her as the "demon-feline" and "puss-in-boots" of their tale, and she firmly corrected them: she is a nekomata. In her own quest (Narration Footnotes) she and the Traveler unearthed the three histories of the city's clans and caught the "detective" who had knocked out a resident. He turned out to be the story's narrator, a being who feared his life was only fiction.

At the climax Kirara followed the Traveler toward the "Evil Dragon", flung them back onto solid ground with her tails when the platform gave way, and gave her blessing as "the Nekomata-in-Boots of this world" to the misunderstood little dragon (Durin). Afterward she stayed to explore the Forest of Blessings. She kept the outfit, offered to guide any Simulankans who visit Teyvat, and said that now it is her turn to tell Granny stories.

7.comment: Kirara: Inazuma acquaintances (Sara, Heizou, Itto, Raiden)
7.content: Kujou Sara: Kirara longs to ask about her wings (do they shed? would the feathers line a box?) but is too intimidated, so she watches from afar. Sara has felt the stare and wishes the nekomata would just approach. Shikanoin Heizou had her find missing cats, but when they said they only wanted to see the world, she lied for them and he saw straight through it. Arataki Itto: an oni with his own gang and human friends, whom she envies and wants advice from. Parcels to Tenshukaku come wrapped in layer on layer, and some smell delicious. Kirara once explored its roof uninvited.

8.comment: Kirara: Customers abroad (Yoimiya, Dori, Lisa, Hu Tao, Lyney)
8.content: Yoimiya relies on her to bring firework-colouring ingredients just in time. She once gave Kirara a firework as thanks, but Kirara was too scared to light it, so Yoimiya told her to find a viewing spot far away and offered to set it off for her. Dori stocks foreign goods through her, praises her service and prices, and has noticed she likes pretty accessories. Lisa received a collection of Inazuman books from her (Alchemical Ascension, limited). Hu Tao signed for a parcel in Liyue and asked unsettling questions. In Fontaine, Kirara met Lyney and is half convinced his tricks are youkai powers.

9.content: During the limited-time 4.5 event Alchemical Ascension, Kirara was in Mondstadt as a hired "consultant" for General Gorou, who had got lost. In exchange he was to recommend Komaniya Express on Watatsumi Island. She played along with military reporting ("Affirmative, General!") until he asked her to drop the formalities. She knows Mondstadt well from past deliveries, and she hates getting her tails wet.

10.comment: Kirara: Ioroi and the tanuki of Chinju Forest
10.content: Every time a delivery takes Kirara through Chinju Forest, Ioroi, the stone-bodied bake-danuki who guards it, seals her in with a barrier and makes her play hide-and-seek with the little tanuki. In a 5.7 anecdote he had Gyoubu Koban deliver her parcel for her, but the receipt still needed signing. Kirara stormed off after it, threatening never to clean his moss again. She describes him as nice but tiring, and she naps and sharpens her claws in that forest.

11.comment: Kirara: Liyue food troubles (Xiangling and Chongyun)
11.content: In 5.7 anecdotes, after delivering fresh Inazuman fish to Wanmin Restaurant, Kirara was served boiled fish and onigiri by Xiangling and was overwhelmed by the heat and spice. Xiangling fetched Chongyun, whose own condition keeps him away from hot food, and he made cold noodles with mountain delicacies. Chongyun said he had always wanted to see supernatural beings, so Kirara promised to take him by boat to meet Itto, Ioroi and Granny, while reassuring him they are good youkai.

12.comment: Kirara: Durin's Cat in a Box (6.2)
12.content: In Durin's Story Quest (Draco Rubedo Chapter, Act I, 6.2), the Traveler re-enters the story of Simulanka. Kirara, Navia and Nilou appear only as voices, cast as Durin remembered them: a "cat in a box", a giraffe king and a flying squirrel fairy. The cat in a box first asked whether they were friend or foe, then told the little dragon, "I'm just a cat in a box... but I'd very much like to be your friend too." Durin, now human in Mondstadt, says the cats of The Cat's Tail would not get so nervous around him if they were all like Kirara.

13.content: During the limited-time 6.6 event Phantasmal Pals, the Little Hexenzirkel children (Klee, Qiqi, Sayu, Yaoyao and Prune) were hunting nightmare fragments in Inazuma. Prune yanked a pair of tails hanging from a tree, and it was Kirara, napping after sharpening her claws on a light delivery day. She declined Prune's peace offering of yarn (with visible effort), told Sayu the best napping spots are a cardboard box or a grandmother's lap, and told Klee that a cat-eared person only grows a second tail if she is a nekomata. Her usual tree had "felt off", which led them to the fragment. Klee calls her "Miss Cat Lady".

14.content: By the 6.x era her routes reach Nod-Krai. On the Curatorium of Secrets message board in Nasha Town she thanks Jahoda for a mountain shortcut that saved two deliveries and says Jahoda moves through the mountains even faster than she does. Her 2026 birthday letter has her catching a ship to chase down a Nod-Krai customer who was out hunting Frostfin Whales and wanted Kamera equipment, while she worries about falling in the sea.

15.content: Clients who once gave Kirara snacks sometimes find small, unmarked, prettily decorated boxes at their doors. Inside are trinkets she collected on her routes: a dried Nilotpala Lotus, a Starconch ornament, or an oddly patterned scarab for households with children. She makes the boxes herself because company rules forbid exchanges between staff and clients. Granny's house receives the most of them.
